title: Target HUD
description: Look at any entity within 6 blocks and a small HUD above the crosshair shows its name, type, and HP bar. Color-coded by category. Toggle with K.
body:
**Target HUD** is a tiny client-side overlay that gives you instant info on whatever your crosshair is pointing at.

- Aim at any entity within **6 blocks** and a clean panel appears just above the crosshair.
- Shows the entity's **name** and, for named (nametagged) entities, the underlying **type** on a second line.
- For mobs/players/animals (anything with HP): a **horizontal health bar** that fills proportionally to current HP, plus exact **numeric HP** ("18 / 20 HP").
- The bar color reflects state of health - green above 66 %, yellow 33-66 %, red below 33 %.
- The name is **color-coded** by category:
  - **red** - hostile mob (zombie, skeleton, creeper, ...)
  - **yellow** - other players
  - **green** - passive or neutral living entity (cow, sheep, villager, wolf, ...)
  - **white** - non-living entity (item frame, painting, boat, minecart, ...)
- The panel hides automatically when you look away, open a screen, or press F1 (HUD-hidden).
- Toggle the whole feature with **K**.

Pure client-side, no server install needed. No mixins, no world rendering - built on the stable `MinecraftClient.crosshairTarget` + Fabric `HudRenderCallback` path, so the same JAR loads on Minecraft 1.21.8 through 1.21.11.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Java: 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11
- Mod loader: Fabric Loader >= 0.16.0
- Java: 21+
- Required mods: Fabric API
